description:
You are a machine learning engineer preparing training data for an experiment. You need to list all available containers on the system using Apptainer, and save the output to a text file. Please do the following:

- List all Apptainer container image files in the directory /home/user/project/data/containers. These files have the ".sif" extension.
- Write this listing to the file /home/user/project/container_list.txt.
- The output format should be a plain-text list, with one line per container image filename (no path, just the filename), sorted alphabetically.
- Do not add any extra headers, explanations or decorations to the file. Only the names as specified above, sorted.
- If there are no .sif files, the file should be empty.
